description: Orders for the scripted actor on the reference scenario: red_001 walks three cells toward BLUE, then orders a strike on blue_003 that SKYVAULT rejects (distance 3, range 1 when run as runtime.scheduled_actions on the Phase 5 system): a script decides what to try, SKYVAULT decides whether it can happen. Each order is a valid scheduled action once tick, actor_id and system_id are added.
